paragraphs: Chipotle is an American restaurant chain that sells Mexican-style food. On October 28, the company shared its results for the third quarter of 2026. Some numbers were weak, but investors liked the report.

Total revenue grew 9.6% from a year earlier, to $3.3 billion. Sales at older restaurants rose 2.1%. Experts had expected only 1.5%. Part of this growth came from transactions. A transaction is one sale, such as one customer paying for one meal. The number of transactions rose 0.8%. The average amount that each customer spent rose 1.3%.

The chief executive, Scott Boatwright, said that three consecutive quarters of growth in transactions demonstrate that the company's plan for growth is working. He also said that Chipotle's share of the customer's wallet was stable or growing. In other words, customers spent the same part or a bigger part of their dining money at Chipotle. This was true for people of different incomes and ages.
Profits were weaker. The operating margin fell to 13.7% from 15.9%. Earnings per share were $0.27, down from $0.29 a year earlier. Experts had expected $0.29.
Why were profits lower? Chipotle spent money on special offers. For example, it had a back-to-school deal: buy one meal and get one free. It also gave customers double protein for free.

The cost of food, drinks and packaging fell to 29.5% of revenue, from 30.0%. Higher menu prices helped. A lower tax on goods from other countries also helped. But inflation partially took away this benefit. Inflation means that prices rise over time. Beef was one of the ingredients that cost more. Beef is a common meat in Chipotle's food, so the price of this ingredient matters. According to the chief financial officer, Adam Rymer, Chipotle raised menu prices 2.7% because of inflation. So the higher prices partially made up for the higher costs.

Chipotle opened 84 new restaurants of its own. Of these, 53 have a Chipotlane. This is a lane where people can pick up food they ordered online without leaving their car. The company says these lanes make Chipotle more convenient for guests. Chipotle also has a plan to equip its restaurants with new kitchen machines that work more efficiently. It says it has made significant progress. The goal is to equip kitchens to work faster.

For the full year, Chipotle still expects sales at older restaurants to grow a few percent. It plans to open 350 to 370 new restaurants. Partners will run 10 to 15 of them outside the United States. About 80% of its new restaurants will have a Chipotlane, which is a convenient way to get food. But Rymer warned that October was weaker, like the rest of the dining industry.

The results highlight two sides of the story: more customers, but lower profits. Investors focused on the good news about transactions. On October 29, the stock was up 9%, at $31.19, in the middle of the day. But the stock is still down 16% this year.
